# Isaiah Chapter 59 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 21 verses]*

*Sin separates; no justice; truth stumbles; God puts on armor; Redeemer comes to Zion*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 59 (Sin, Confession, Redemption) addresses sin separates; no justice; truth stumbles; god puts on armor; redeemer comes to zion. The key verse — "The LORD's arm is not too short to save, nor his ear too dull to hear" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Third Isaiah (chs. 56-66), focused on the restored community and eschatological hope.
